newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar rangebound before expiry.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar rangebound before expiry.

text.p: London's white sugar market ended a dull day little changed with interest on the December/March spread and traders rolling spot positions forward before expiry.

Volume was fairly light totalling 1821 lots. December last traded just 30 cents higher at $304.00 after an intraday low of $303.40. March was 20 cents higher at $303.50. Mixed buying in the second-month March kept values supported but activity was subdued. Fresh physical news was thin.
